facts.subject: main/melee/ef/efsync:efSync_Spawn
facts.value: Uses gfx_id to decode the variadic payload and select a construction path. Position vectors and JObj pointers flow into particle or attachment constructors; owner transforms and facing values flow into effect scale and rotation; random values generate orientations and movement parameters; and successful effects receive callbacks, lifetimes, attachment pointers, parameters, animation, or next links before the primary object is returned.

facts.subject: main/melee/ef/efsync:efSync_Spawn
facts.value: Initializes effect loading as asynchronous and clears the animation queue for every call. Direct-generator and delegated ID ranges return early; IDs handled by the local switch first change loading to synchronous mode. Successful recipes may install per-frame callbacks, finite lifetimes, attachment state, or ordered effect chains, and local dispatch always drains the queued animation entries from newest to oldest before returning.
facts.reason: Correct routing boundaries and delegated mode assumptions.
